name: Akari Watanabe
source: Akari is a young elementary school student and Aki's younger cousin, she is very different compared to many people her age, being fond of traditional Japanese dancing and ballads. She's very proper and polite, although she can sometimes show her more childlike side. She's very independent and skilled, being able to make delicious ramen and other Japanese foods.
